   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19097001" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/97/#v19097001" target="_blank">Psalm 97:1</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Rejoice, give glory to Jehovah,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">For the heavens proclaim all his righteousness.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">Let us sing to our God joyful songs to his praise;</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">Let us speak to all of his great acts.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp">Let the heavens rejoice, Let the earth joyful be,</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz">For Jehovah has become our King!</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp">Let the heavens rejoice, Let the earth joyful be,</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz">For Jehovah has become our King!</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>His glory tell among the nations;</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">For Jehovah to us is a God who saves.</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">Yes, Jehovah is King; he deserves all the praise.</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">So we bow before his mighty throne.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sp">Let the heavens rejoice, Let the earth joyful be,</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sz">For Jehovah has become our King!</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sp">Let the heavens rejoice, Let the earth joyful be,</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sz">For Jehovah has become our King!</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>His righteous rule is now established.</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sz">On his throne, he has placed his anointed Son.</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sp">Let the gods of this world</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sz">be brought down and be shamed,</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">For the praise belongs to God alone.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">Let the heavens rejoice, Let the earth joyful be,</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">For Jehovah has become our King!</p>
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 sp">Let the heavens rejoice, Let the earth joyful be,</p>
<p id="p31" data-pid="31" class="p31 sz">For Jehovah has become our King!</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p32" data-pid="32" class="p32 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="13016009" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/1-chronicles/16/#v13016009" target="_blank">1 Chron. 16:9;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19068020" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/68/#v19068020" target="_blank"> Ps. 68:20;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19097006-19097007" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/97/#v19097006-v19097007" target="_blank"> 97:6, 7</a>.)</p>
</div>
